question: The premier iron ore exporting port of India is situated in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Goa.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **main port** used by the nation to **export iron ore is Marmagao port** in Goa.
 
• Almost **50% of India's exports **of** iron ore **come from this port.
 
• A port is a location **where ships can load and unload their cargo** near the margin of an **ocean, river, or lake.**
 
• The port is located on **India's west coast.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The most common iron ores discovered in India are** magnetite and hematite.**
 
• Iron ore exports from India reached rs**. 1,293 crore in December 2022,** a 212 percent increase over the Rs. **414 crore sold in December 2021** and a considerable increase above the **Rs.128 crore exported i**n November.
 
• The **tenth most exported good** from India was iron ore.
 
• **China, Japan, Malaysia, Oman, and Indonesia **are India's top export destinations for iron ore.
